source.snippet: Very confused with Microsoft Graph permissions... First provided App based permissions (as I understand that doesn't require periodic approvals of access), but then realised one can't send Teams messages with that way of getting permissions (as if there would be never a need for this Microsoft!). Then pivoted to delegated permissions, but can't seem to get User.Read.All to be seen, or usable on the PC side.

problem_statement: Developers and IT admins integrating Microsoft Graph struggle to understand and correctly configure permission scopes (app vs. delegated), leading to wasted hours and blocked automation projects inside companies.
target_segment: IT admins and developers at SMB-to-enterprise companies building M365/Teams integrations
notes: Single post but reflects a widely-documented, recurring pain across StackOverflow/ServerFault/Reddit. Business context is clear: the user is building a company integration and is blocked. Time-waste is implicit (multi-step failed attempts). Opportunity: a plain-language Graph permissions configurator/validator tool. Buyer would be a dev or IT team at a company paying for M365.
